::: {#exr-conv-shape}

#### The shape of a convolution's output

`nn.Conv2d(1, 8, 3, padding=1)` is a [convolutional layer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-convolutional-layer)
with 1 input [channel](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-channel),
8 output [channels](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-channel),
$3 \times 3$ [filters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-filter)
and [padding](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-padding) 1.
What [shape](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-shape) is its output for the first 32 training images?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
The DATA 471 notes give the [output size of a convolution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#thm-output-size).
